notes.title: 🔄 Update 0.8.2.0 - Closed Testing Phase
notes.content:
I'm excited to roll out Update 0.8.2.0, which brings a host of enhancements to the campaign map, NPC interactions, enemy AI, and overall game stability. 

🏙️ Campaign Map - Fundis Cityscape Overhaul (Phase 1)
We've completely reimagined Fundis City with this major overhaul:
- New landscape design for a more immersive urban experience
- Improved building architecture throughout the cityscape
- Enhanced player manoeuvrability for smoother navigation
- Dynamic environmental elements that bring the city to life
- Upgraded foliage systems delivering richer visual fidelity
- Comprehensive testing and optimization across all cityscape improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838033/a5931e9e07b637eecc35221d042cf500a6e8ab43.png[/img]

🤖 NPC Systems Revolution
Our dialogue systems have received a complete overhaul:
- Full NPC Dialogue System implementation with comprehensive setup and configuration
- Guide NPC Blueprint creation for better player assistance
- New Dialogue Data Structure for more flexible conversations
- Advanced NPC Dialogue Mechanics for deeper interactions
- Face Animation integration bringing NPCs to life during conversations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838033/a66c023307e6fadfa78941eaf8a08733c52b9946.png[/img]

⚔️ Enemy Enhancements - AMU Combat Evolution
The AMU Humanoid Enemy Robots have received major upgrades:
- Voice System implementation for AMUs with contextual audio cues
- Complete Combat System setup for more engaging encounters
- Random voice commands that adapt to AMU behavioural states
- Visual customization system for varied enemy appearances
- Suspicious activity tracking that dynamically adjusts AMU responses to player behaviour
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838033/cccb69e0fc35331f88964a09b247a145acd9f2be.png[/img]

🎯 Character & Weapons
- Enhanced character effects for improved visual feedback
- Phase 1 weapons system upgrades initiated for future combat improvements

🔧 Bug Fixes
We've addressed several critical issues:
- Fixed overlapping NPC dialogue when skipping speech too quickly
- Resolved ambient sound interference with NPC speech clarity
- Corrected first-person view rendering issues with player face meshes and hair/beard assets
- Fixed character feet clipping through uneven terrain surfaces
- Resolved display settings not saving properly in system configuration
- Completed comprehensive Dialogue System testing and debugging

Thank you for your continued support as The Trip is expanded and developed further. Your feedback drives these improvements, so keep sharing your thoughts with the community!

Happy exploring!
- Thomas

notes.title: 🔄 Update 0.8.1.0 - Closed Testing Phase
notes.content:
Welcome to the next chapter of The Trip! Version 0810 is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838033/445c5d883ed3816df1b7c25a3e6bad49e0b61122.png[/img]

🆕 New Features & Improvements
Engine Upgrade: Transitioned to Unreal Engine 5.5.4 for improved performance and graphical fidelity.

NPC Enhancements: NPCs now utilize Metahumans 4 for lifelike animations and design, alongside a new generator system for randomized character diversity.

Gameplay Features: Steam Achievements added, inverse kinematics for realistic foot placement, enemy AI spawns, loot chests, and climbing mechanics in Fundis City.

🌄 Visual & Environmental Upgrades
Forest overhaul with redesigned trees, bushes, and terrain layers for a more immersive landscape.

Enhanced post-processing effects and improved sky animations for captivating atmospheres.

🎨 UI & Audio Updates
Redesigned settings menu and dashboard UI for better usability.

Balanced audio with ambient sounds and improved footstep intensity for a richer soundscape.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Addressed interaction issues, animation glitches, UI padding problems, and environmental inconsistencies to ensure smoother gameplay.

This update is currently in closed testing and not publicly available yet. We’re committed to refining every detail before releasing it to the community. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue shaping The Trip into an unforgettable adventure!

Thank you for your continued support and commitment to helping us make this game the best it can be!

Thomas
